  The document `ccx pr post-review` reads. Long prose hand-written as a JSON string
  loses its whole meaning to one missed escape, so writing plain markdown and naming it
  is the supported way round.

  assessment         string (required), one of:
                     The verdict, which decides whether the review is posted as an
                     approval, a request for changes or a comment.
    Approve可能        A review with nothing that has to change. The values are Japanese
                     because the review file they are read out of is written by a skill
                     that speaks Japanese, and these are what it writes.
    修正が必要            A review with something that has to change.
    要議論              A review that asks rather than tells.
  exactly one of:
    body             string (optional)
                     The review body, written inline.
    body_file        string (optional, a bare file name, not empty)
                     The name of a markdown file in the work dir holding the body. A
                     path would let a review reach round the directory binding that
                     keeps parallel runs on different pull requests apart.
  comments           array of object (required)
                     The remarks anchored to lines of the diff, empty for a review that
                     is all body.
    path             string (required)
    line             integer (required)
                     The line number on the new side of the diff.
    exactly one of:
      body           string (optional)
                     The remark, inline or named, exactly as the review body is.
      body_file      string (optional, a bare file name, not empty)
